# TechPi

> TechPi is an independent technology business in Xanthi, Greece, and the evolution of pigiota314. It designs and builds websites, e-shops, web applications, SaaS platforms and AI integrations for businesses in Greece, and websites and digital platforms for EU-funded projects (Horizon Europe, Erasmus+, Interreg and other programmes). It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the European Commission.

The site is bilingual: English at https://techpi.eu/ and Greek at https://techpi.eu/el/. Contact: info@techpi.eu.

## Services (English)

- [EU project websites and digital platforms](https://techpi.eu/eu-projects): websites, platforms, web applications and support for EU-funded research, innovation and cooperation projects.
- [Capabilities](https://techpi.eu/capabilities): digital products, web experiences (websites and e-commerce), intelligence (AI and automation), digital visibility (SEO and GEO).
- [Website and e-shop development in Xanthi, Greece](https://techpi.eu/web-design-xanthi)
- [Websites for holiday rentals and small hotels](https://techpi.eu/accommodation-websites), with a live demo.
- [Work](https://techpi.eu/work): client projects, each with a case study.
- [Insights](https://techpi.eu/insights): notes on EU project websites, deliverables, accessibility and dissemination.
- [About](https://techpi.eu/about) · [Contact](https://techpi.eu/contact)

## Selected case studies

- [Rocketeer](https://techpi.eu/work/rocketeer): delivery operations platform.
- [Arman's Ethnic Street Food](https://techpi.eu/work/armans): direct online ordering platform.
- [Rantevo.gr](https://techpi.eu/work/rantevo): multi-sector SaaS booking platform.
- [Saloon](https://techpi.eu/work/saloon) and [Physio](https://techpi.eu/work/physio): booking and client management platforms.
- [Logotherapia Xanthi](https://techpi.eu/work/logotherapia-xanthi): website for a speech and occupational therapy centre in Xanthi.
